description: This file is a PHP script that demonstrates how to initialize and configure the Google OAuth2 provider using the league/oauth2-google library. It sets up client credentials, redirect URI, starts a session, and returns the provider object.

classes.name: Google
classes.description: A class from League\'s OAuth2 client library representing the Google provider.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor of the Google provider class, initialized with client ID, secret, and redirect URI.
